_comment: Single source of truth for this plugin's i18n build + gate. Consumed by Gruntfile.js (makepot:wpcli / makemo / makejson) and by bin/i18n-verify.py. Keep it here, not duplicated in either consumer, so the POT the gate regenerates is byte-comparable to the POT the build ships.
_jsFallbackAllowedKeys_comment: Keys a JS `l10n.key || 'English'` may reference that this plugin does not localize itself - e.g. Pro reading a payload the FREE plugin provides. Keep it empty unless there is a real cross-plugin read; an entry here is a permanent English string nobody can translate if it turns out to be wrong.
